1 / Command

Ada Mensah. Follow code toward the bench.

For embedded firmware roles. My working documents are a state table, a timing diagram and a current trace. I wrote Mosslink’s firmware and built its bring-up fixture.

What does a physical observation add to a firmware decision?

Seven probe connectors form an explanatory measurement loom, derived from fixture access and bench observation. Not actual cabling or wiring.

See the middle · Evidence & contact

2 / Observation

The observation leaves a question open.

After a failed transmission, a current trace showed the radio staying awake. No cause, fix, timing or later resolution is confirmed. This sequence is conceptual: there is no trace available to publish.

Connectors open into ordered command, observation and question positions. Spacing is not elapsed time, and no waveform is drawn.

3 / Interpretation

Describe only what the evidence supports.

Forty engineering samples were assembled; six were tested on the bench. None went to customers. A two-year battery projection and a 72-hour longest run are different kinds of evidence.

The loom rejoins while Estimate and Run retain separate labels: connecting evidence does not erase its limits.

ADA MENSAH / LOCAL CONCEPT STUDY

From firmware
to observation.

Three scroll sketches. Each has an opening, a middle and an ending carried by one tangible object. Geometry is explanatory; it does not reconstruct Mosslink or depict test evidence.

01 / Bring-up checklist
The bring-up fixture ↗

Command, access and observation separate from the same solid fixture. Recommended: closest to the fixture Ada built and the work a hiring manager needs to understand.

02 / State table
The power-state assembly ↗

A generic sensor assembly separates planning from observation, using a labelled teaching loop.

03 / Timing diagram reading
The observation loom ↗

Probe connectors order the relationship between command, observation and an open question, without invented timings or traces.

Choose the story structure first. Typography, colour and final wording will have their own review.
